digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler backend port and DC transport adapter
propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError but core modules catch only urllib.error.HTTPError, causing exceptions to escape and fail reconciliation instead of degrading gracefully
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue cannot classify remotely-deleted DC issues as _DELETED because JIRAError does not match the HTTPError.code == 404 check, breaking deletion detection silently
core modules reference vendor-specific urllib.error.HTTPError directly, creating a transport leak in vendor-neutral code
BackendHTTPError declared as a urllib.error.HTTPError subclass preserves .code attribute and matches existing exception handlers without requiring core edits
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary while preserving HTTP status codes
